message.content:

    Thought rivers carry data across sleeping oceans.
      Air doors open onto private, quieter timelines.
        Clocks fold themselves when no one is watching.
          Mountain engines hum tides into gentle obedience.
            Starlight seeds grow into lantern trees at night.
              Memory bridges ferry lost languages back home.
